summary: Five unique multifamily sales comps in Charlotte meeting all criteria (closed, stabilized, single-asset, fee-simple, unrelated-party, 52–116 units, within 8 miles, 2025-09-01 to 2026-08-31) were selected and ranked by proximity: R5793 (0.8 mi), R2721 (1.03 mi, amended price $27.9M), R1038 (1.26 mi), R4976 (1.49 mi), and R1363 (1.72 mi). Duplicates (R5793/R8631) were noted and deduped; executed amendment U-R2721-1 was applied; a post-cutoff amendment to R1038 and an unsigned draft for R4976 were excluded. Several records were ineligible due to listing status, redevelopment, related party, minority interest, portfolio/unallocated pricing, wrong size unit, distance, out-of-window dates, non-multifamily asset type, null consideration, or evidence published after cutoff. A comp-grid XLSX with citations has been created.
limitations: Only the provided extracts and updates were used; no external verification of geocoding or unit counts.
Price-per-unit was computed directly from stated consideration and unit counts; no adjustments for unit mix, condition beyond stabilized, or concessions.
One qualifying nearby sale (R9650) was not selected due to the distance-first ranking requirement limiting the shortlist to five comps.
Event and publication dates were assumed accurate as provided; timing nuances (e.g., recording vs. closing dates) were not independently confirmed.
